volatility.title: Volatility
volatility.why_it_matters: VIX curve backwardation flags acute near-term event risk and dealer-driven stress.

sections.question: What is the vol surface signaling about near-term risk appetite?
sections.answer: Data not yet active for this section.
sections.why: When the VIX curve inverts into backwardation, dealers hedge aggressively and risk assets typically reprice sharply within days.
sections.risk: A sudden spike in VVIX above 120 would signal vol-of-vol stress even if spot VIX stays low.
sections.support: Contango term structure and low VIX9D/VIX ratio both confirm orderly near-term positioning.
sections.caveat: MOVE Index and Cboe SKEW are unavailable; bond vol context is incomplete.
